sent: This is a normal heartbeat. [pause 0.3] The S-A node fires, the signal travels down through the A-V node, and both ventricles squeeze together. [pause 0.45] Now watch what happens in atrial flutter. [pause 0.35] One electrical loop circles the right atrium about 300 times a minute, drawing a sawtooth on the monitor. [pause 0.4] Often the A-V node passes every second wave, so the heart rate sits near 150. [pause 0.45] If the patient is unstable, use synchronized cardioversion. [pause 0.35] If stable, control the rate, and remember flutter carries stroke risk too. [pause 0.5] Practice it on A-C-L-S med Sim. [pause 0.35] A-C-L-S med dot com. [pause 1.2]
